Account.description: A checksum-valid ordinary Stellar account address.

Address.description: Checksum validation and role/address-kind checks are required in addition to this shape.

Amount.description: Base-unit integer, at most signed i128 maximum. Token arithmetic and aggregate bounds are checked semantically.

PositiveAmount.description: Strictly positive base-unit integer within i128.

Xdr.description: Base64 Stellar XDR, with decoded payload at most 65536 bytes. Enforce canonical encoding.

agreement.description: Exact UTF-8 body, at most 10000 bytes, matching terms.agreement.

FundingPolicy.description: All min/max ranges require min <= max. Prompt mode also requires a separately supplied SDK approveFunding callback; it is not serialized in JSON.

RestorationRequirement.description: estimatedFee is in native XLM base units, not USDC. Restored keys must be within the requested action dependency allowlist.

body.description: At most 10000 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization after hashing. Plain text only.
At most 10000 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization after hashing. Plain text only.
At most 10000 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization after hashing. Plain text only.
At most 10000 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization after hashing. Plain text only.

PaymentResponse.description: Success confirms funding of the protected agreement, not immediate seller payout. Processing has null receipt and an authenticated statusUrl; delivered/no_charge has a matching receipt.

walletSession.description: 1800-second account, network and service-origin scoped wallet session. Never grants contract transaction authorization.

x-provider-quote-contract.idempotency: Required; deterministic key from scope, arbiter and exact fee. Pending results are reconciled before requesting another registration.

x-semantic-validation: Validate Stellar address checksums and address kinds.
Validate i128 amounts and exact principal-plus-reserve funding sums.
Bind origin, network, deployment, complete terms, quotes, signature authority and exact invocation trees.
Verify ordinary account master signer authority against current thresholds for login, provider admission and resource proofs.
Enforce UTF-8 byte sizes, not just character lengths.
Reconcile original transactions before replacement; unknown is not proof of failure.
Reject a claim with nonpositive amount; no-charge receipts have no claim.

x-protected-http-profile.digest: SHA-256(UTF-8 domain prefix followed by RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes)
